notes.title: Performance & foliage update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I got a Steamdeck on my birthday so I made some performance optimisation in the game that should affect everyone. Especially on volcano level, forest level and shadow level. The target was to reach a constant 60 FPS on the deck : it's a success !

Here's the changelog
- Optimisation in volcano level, forest level and void level (mostly concerning lighting ; render calls optimisation & level loading / unloading)
- More foliage in forest level (it's cheap now to render that, so I cracked it up a bit !)
- Special settings applied if you play on a deck (mostly concerning shadows : they are so greedy !)

I hope you'll enjoy, if you find bugs or problems you can reach out to me via discussions !
Have a good weekend !
Narom

notes.title: Official Livesplit Integration
notes.content:
Hi there !

After watching some friends speedrunning Pillars of Light (Dahpril lately on TwitchTV, just to name him), I worked a bit on a better integration with the most common speedrunning tool : Livesplit.
Pillars of Light now has an official category in the settings and an autosplitter !
It will allow speedrunner to ignore loading times (because your loading speed should not make you better or worse than a fellow speedrunner !) but also automatically change the current step of your speedrun. 

I know it's a niche feature ! But now has never been a better time to beat this 42 minutes run and get the achievement ! 42 minutes is easy, the competition is now sub-30, will you try to beat that ? :)

Have a good one !

PS : 

Here's the "official" list of splits :
- Introduction
- House
- Temple
- Attack
- Jungle
- Transition
- Sewers
- Cinematic
- Volcano
- Desert
- Cinematic
- The void
- Cinematic
